originalHandoff.body:
## Qualified interpolation packet: detached custody, source still held

The local exact arithmetic and real file/stdin capability is accepted by independent native and root source/content receiving. It is **not integrated or browser/hosted qualified**.

Immutable custody: [estate-e827/polynomial-interpolation-native-custody at a9626b52](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/RecallWeave/tree/a9626b52ab65bf7e9896e60de340ffbb04333509/docs/receiving/polynomial-interpolation-e82707f2bc62/held), tree `9e91273cbf9afe57dcc1d84d4445865c6ac66111`, true parent `698902f9c9c1d5c5023092b85b3632a7cb7a01ed`. All **2,915 existing source/workflow leaves** retain their exact blobs, modes and types; the only six additions are under this unique archive directory. All six complete payloads, both archives, the full tree, commit and branch ref were read back exactly. No PR or main update was made. The exact-head Actions query returned **0 runs** after branch creation.

- Original `native-packet-v1.zip`: 86,731 bytes, SHA256 `527363673875aeb20bec831561d283e22daf435d5c603d8b2f1a9ef8766e2947`, Git `cf1aba3d8942fa7d8049db774ee82af9e20c8ab8`; all 36 members preserved, including the original source and failures.
- `prose-successor-v1.zip`: 9,295 bytes, SHA256 `3c60fe20e49c69c8bb46448d9fca597009546cfa738d24a725b65c13a3b82f97`, Git `e3f9fd93c91b4252ba1a0851493fe8981b690473`; five members contain the corrected deck, one-clause inverse proof and final root review. The v1 packet is unchanged.

Actual native evidence remains source-specific: **13/13 author methods** at the original deck, **6/6 unchanged independent methods** versus one existing control plus five absent-feature baseline failures, and **18/18 blind question answers**. Node24.19.0 executed exact rational triangles/forms, permutation and effective degree, duplicate/accessor/admission refusals, real file/stdin/literal-dash/64KiB and output-I/O boundaries. Core `1e84c2d5` and CLI `a38ebfee` are unchanged. Root corrected only one explanation: 13/4 is itself binary-exact; the successor retains that fractional form without implying otherwise. Every prompt, option and answer is unchanged. No broad test replay or new pass count was attributed to that prose change.

The original setup ENOSPC partial and original missing model/command evidence remain in custody. Two text-only blob-read interface errors during archival verification are retained as receiver errors; the supported explicit-base64 file readback then verified every byte. They are not product failures or hidden source changes.

[Jacob's no-Actions direction](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/hamon/issues/143#issuecomment-6067592767) remains controlling. Before mutation, root and source workers read the complete actual current tree `d6d3707b` and all five workflow definitions: only pull requests and pushes restricted to main; no issue/comment or other-branch push/create event. This distinct non-main custody branch with no PR matches none of those checked events. The required browser/catalog/current-source/hosted/integration gates remain held or unrun; no workflow suppression, paid replacement or source activation occurred.

  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Keep the existing workflows intact and use their pinned action identities.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Check maintained receiver syntax
        run: node --check tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - name: Verify the committed standalone learner
        run: |
          python3 tools/make_demo.py
          git diff --exit-code -- demo.html
      - name: Receive visible answer identities with installed Chrome
        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          node tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --browser "$chrome_bin" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-feedback-receiving" --emit-bundle

      - '.github/workflows/course-handout-browser.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-handout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, inherited project pin
      - name: Require cached Node 22 and an installed system browser
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION=
          for HANDOUT_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION="${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR##*/}"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required; no runtime will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'node=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          HANDOUT_BROWSER=
          for HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              HANDOUT_BROWSER="$(command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required; no browser will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'browser=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" --version
          command -v python3
          if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext -v; else echo "pdftotext unavailable; PDF artifacts require separate direct inspection."; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, inherited project pin
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.native.outputs.node }}
      - name: Install and identify the standard CJK print font
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive actual studio, file selection, separate downloads and print artifacts
        run: node tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.native.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/course-handout-receiving"
      - name: Verify the direct-open teacher page matches its modular sources
        run: python3 tools/make_handout.py --check
      - name: Preserve bounded original browser and print artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4, verified from the official tag
        with:
          name: course-handout-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/course-handout-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6
